events.name: Boxing Dog
events.description: Your pet sits up in the front passenger seat at night, stares out at the traffic, then throws a flurry of fast punches at the windscreen with its front paws.

events.name: Dog Grooming Time
events.description: Your pet sits on the grooming table, slaps the clippers away, kicks the first groomer across the room into the kennels, beats the second one in a kung fu fight and shaves a bald stripe down the back of their head.

events.name: Giant Horse Statue Hideout
events.description: You run to a giant chrome horse statue on an empty highway, climb into a hatch in its belly and hide, then watch on a screen inside, close to tears, while suited figures in black hammer at the horse.

events.name: Glove Knock
events.description: You in a phone selfie as two springy cartoon boxing gloves, one red and one blue, pop up from the bottom of the screen and knock your face again and again, until it squashes, wobbles like jelly and blushes bright red.

events.name: Missed Train Dance
events.description: You in a black suit and pink tie, sprinting down the station stairs, missing the train by a second, dropping to your knees in despair, then shrugging it off with a full-on dance in the station.

events.name: Monkey Eating Apple
events.description: You take a big bite of a red apple on a sunny forest path, a macaque leaps off the wooden railing and grabs it, you wrestle it back, then it snatches the apple for good and runs off, and the video ends on your wide-eyed stare into the lens.

events.name: My Moon My Man
events.description: A soft oil painting of you kneeling to pick one tiny white wildflower while Jesus stands just behind you, hiding a huge pastel bouquet behind his back.

events.name: Peephole Puppy
events.description: You look through the front-door peephole and your pet is right there: its nose huge in the round fisheye view, eyes up at you, head tilting, mouth opening as if to say "it's me, open up".

events.name: Reaching Out Cat
events.description: A hand reaches up at a spinning ceiling fan, then the video cuts to your pet sitting calmly by the Christmas tree, and hands swoop in from the side and whisk it out of frame.

events.name: Suave Cat Dance
events.description: Your pet stands up on its hind legs on a beach at night in a spiked black belt, between two kittens, and dances the Suave cat dance: paws to the chest, a turn to wiggle its hips at the camera, then paws flung out wide, city lights behind.

events.name: Talk Dirty Dance
events.description: You lead Jason Derulo's "Talk Dirty" dance break on a dark arena stage: a crew in yellow-and-black and red jackets falls in behind you, a spotlight picks you out and a jet of fire shoots up beside you.

events.name: Tying Shoe Money
events.description: You set a plastic cup down on a park path and crouch to tie your shoe, and passers-by start dropping cash into it: by the end the cup is stuffed with bills and you can't believe it.

events.name: Villain Trend
events.description: You're the villain in the leather armchair: you swivel round to the camera with your fingertips pressed together, the chair tips back way further than you expected, and you pull yourself together for the close-up.
